launch: ( . /etc/apron_environment && cd /workspace && exec env -u HF_TOKEN -u HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 APRON_PEAK_PROBE=1 APRON_PEAK_PROBE_OUT=/workspace/peak-probe-1.json PYTHONPATH=/workspace/peak_probe VLLM_CACHE_ROOT=/workspace/probe-cache-1 /opt/venv/bin/vllm serve /runpod-volume/models/meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B --served-model-name meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B --dtype bfloat16 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --max-model-len 640 ) > /var/log/vllm.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & ( exec tail -n +1 -F /var/log/vllm.log > /proc/1/fd/1 ) 2>/dev/null < /dev/null &

token_check.command: for p in $(pgrep -f 'bin/[v]llm serve|[V]LLM::'); do n=$(tr '\0' '\n' < /proc/$p/environ | cut -d= -f1 | grep -c -E '^(HF_TOKEN|HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN)$'); echo "$p $n"; done
